people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
translations.bsb: But as for Israel he says: “All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”
translations.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
translations.asv: But as to Israel he saith, All the day long did I spread out my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
